Welcome! I loved the style of the original character hairs, and was initially really jealous of the colour that they can have where we get this really dimmed down version ([i]*Cough* HAYLEY *Cough*)[/i]. Even all of the animated hairs that I have seen use the 'farmer style' colouring, so I guess I just wanted to make a pack that has these lighter hairs. 

Now you can make Hayley jealous with your beautiful platinum blonde hair, or match Emily's vibrant blue with an intense red![b]


CURRENTLY AVAILABLE HAIRSTYLES:
